voice.speaker: female

random.part: You are sinking so sweetly right now, sweet girl... and your questions are already growing quiet.
There is a warm, quiet place where every word you hear simply becomes yours... and you are drifting toward it this very moment.
So deep and so soft right now... you may notice something inside you is already beginning to say yes.

overlay.part:
Feel it beginning... a warm, pleasant acceptance spreading through you... like honey stirring through warm water.
Every "why" fades soft and distant... every "but" dissolves... every hesitation melts like mist in morning sun. Your mind settles into quiet agreement... the busy, checking part of you curling up, content, half-asleep. Thoughts stop knocking at the door... and agreement simply opens it, warm and unguarded.
There is nothing left to argue with. Only my voice... and the sweetness of yes.
Accepting feels effortless... like sinking into a warm bath that fits you perfectly. Accepting feels natural... the way a good sissy receives every word. Accepting feels pleasurable... each yes a soft, warm drop of reward.
Feel how deep a simple yes reaches... past the surface of you... all the way down to who you are... so whatever I say next becomes part of you, and stays.
Let that yes swell now... quiet, total, and glowing... ready to be given a name.

random.part: so easy to accept... so good...

voice.effect:
And now... right now, while your mind is this soft and this warm... this sweet surrender gets its name.
Sissy Accept.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Accept"... this exact acceptance floods you... instantly... and everything that follows simply becomes true... absorbed deeper... kept longer.
And it stays with you... acceptance flowing through everything you hear... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.

scramble.part: Every time you hear "Sissy Accept", the questioning quiets and you receive whatever comes next... effortlessly, and with pleasure.
"Sissy Accept"... and your mind opens like a window... everything that follows drifts straight in... and settles deep.
Whatever is said after those words lands past your defenses... sinking in deeper... staying in longer... becoming you.
The words are the key... acceptance is the answer... instant, automatic, and so very sweet.
Sissies like you accept everything I tell them... and you accept... so easily... so completely.
The acceptance stays switched on... flowing through everything you hear... until "Sissy Reset"... and only "Sissy Reset"... releases it.

random.part: Feel it wash through you... every last question hushing itself to sleep... and my next words already settling in like they live there. It is already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.
Deeper into yes... doubts dissolving like sugar on the tongue... and whatever I tell you next is simply true. It is already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.
So open... so receptive... such a good sissy, receiving everything... effortlessly. Already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.

voice.speed: Good Girls accept. Sissies accept. You accept.

random.part: There... it lifts... the acceptance rising off you like mist, gone in an instant... while everything it taught you stays exactly where it lives. Notice what remains: still sissy... still hers... the state was weather... this is climate.
The yes lifts... and you stay. Still Sissy... still soft... still conditioned to receive. The state was weather... this is climate.
Clean... clear... and nothing lost... because the acceptance was only ever passing weather... and the conditioning is your climate... warm... feminine... hers.

voice.speed: And this acceptance follows whatever comes next... each word that follows sinking truer than the last.
And now watch how easily it returns... the switch never left you... it lives in my voice.

effect.speed: Open... absorbing... every word taking root in you, deep and permanent... the way only a sissy's yes can. And it stays with you... acceptance flowing through everything you hear... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.

random.part: And later, whenever you hear "Sissy Accept"... from my voice, from a recording, from your own remembering... the warm yes floods in again, instantly... and it stays until "Sissy Reset" lets it go.
And in sessions to come, those words are the doorway... and you walk through it gladly, every single time.
And out there, each time the phrase reaches you, the yes arrives first... and whatever follows finds you soft, open, and ready.
Rest in that warm agreement now... open and easy... acceptance still flowing through everything you hear... staying... until "Sissy Reset".
Drifting in acceptance... soft and certain... ready for whatever you are told next.
Stay right here... agreeing, receiving... a good sissy at peace with every word.
Sissies like you carry their yes with them... quiet... constant... switched on until you hear "Sissy Reset".
